properties.label: Huge aperture beside tall type
properties.text: Let a huge physical aperture occupy the left side of a warm stone-gray page. Place tall closely set editorial type and a compact continuous control on the right, with fine labels outside the moving mechanism.

properties.label: Nine-leaf concentric iris
properties.text: Build nine overlapping leaves into a real adjustable circular opening, with precise concentric registration, visible thickness, fine edge bevels, engraved ticks and screws.

properties.label: Ivory enclosure and brushed iris
properties.text: Use an ivory enclosure, dark metal iris leaves and restrained copper-brown details. Add directional reflection on brushed surfaces; dark gaps must read as occlusion rather than a black sticker.

properties.label: Coherent iris control
properties.text: The slider and Narrow, Balanced and Open presets move all nine leaves coherently around one centre. Keep response direct and cover each preset with a poster fallback.

properties.label: Demand-rendered mechanism
properties.text: Render frames on demand as the control moves rather than maintaining unnecessary idle work.

properties.label: Iris range inspection
properties.text: Inspect the opening at minimum, midpoint and maximum. Reject leaf intersections, floating screws and broken circular registration.

properties.label: Scale imbalance on mobile
properties.text: Prevent mobile clipping while preserving the intended object-to-copy scale imbalance.
